# The Record card under the open chat (needs the test hook's chat command): at 1280x720 (426x240) the chat's box
# covers every corner, so each card fades while the chat is open; at GUI scale 2 (640x360) only the bottom left
# card fades and a top left one stays. Before, only a bottom left card faded and chat lines were drawn over the rest.
# (The test world starts at GUI scale 2, so the script sets 3 first.)
# Run it: gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=<branch> -f script=.github/checks/card-chat.txt

cmd time set noon
cmd weather clear
look 0 -20
guiscale 3
set recordCard true
set cardLyrics true
sleep 6
cmd say one
cmd say two
cmd say three
set cardCorner TOP_LEFT
sleep 2
shot card-top-left
chat
sleep 1.5
shot card-top-left-chat
close
set cardCorner TOP_RIGHT
sleep 2
shot card-top-right
chat
sleep 1.5
shot card-top-right-chat
close
set cardCorner BOTTOM_LEFT
sleep 2
shot card-bottom-left
chat
sleep 1.5
shot card-bottom-left-chat
close
set cardCorner BOTTOM_RIGHT
sleep 2
shot card-bottom-right
chat
sleep 1.5
shot card-bottom-right-chat
close
guiscale 2
set cardCorner TOP_LEFT
sleep 2
chat
sleep 1.5
shot card-top-left-chat-g2
close
set cardCorner BOTTOM_LEFT
sleep 2
chat
sleep 1.5
shot card-bottom-left-chat-g2
close
guiscale 0
